speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are experiencing sudden-onset vertigo; to begin my assessment, can you describe exactly how the spinning sensation feels and what specific triggers, such as head movement or changes in position, cause it to start or worsen? Additionally, have you noticed any accompanying symptoms like hearing loss, tinnitus, nausea, or difficulty speaking?

speaker: Patient
text: 59-year-old male. The patient presents to the emergency department with a sudden-onset sensation that the room is spinning, leading to several episodes of nausea and vomiting. The symptoms started as he was going to bed and lasted for approximately 3 minutes. He mentions that he has never experienced anything like this before and currently feels at his baseline.

speaker: Doctor
text: Based on your report of a 3-minute episode of spinning vertigo triggered by moving in bed with no residual symptoms, have you noticed any new weakness, numbness, or difficulty speaking during the event? REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain. REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for confirming the normal imaging results; since the MRI was clear and your symptoms were brief with no neurological deficits, did you notice any specific sounds in your ear, such as roaring or ringing, during the episode? REQUEST TEST: Audiometry.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Within normal limits for age.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since your audiometry results are within normal limits, indicating no hearing loss to suggest Meniere's disease, did you experience a distinct "whooshing" sound in your ear that matches your heartbeat while the room was spinning?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Sudden-onset sensation of the room spinning. I also have Nausea, Vomiting, Dizziness.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV). The clinical presentation of a brief (3-minute) episode of vertigo triggered by position change (going to bed), accompanied by nausea/vomiting, with normal neurological imaging and normal audiometry is classic for BPPV.
